subject: Remittance update & EU VAT residency clarification (Scallop Tech acquisition)
body:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@scalloptech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Remittance update & EU VAT residency clarification (Scallop Tech acquisition)

Hi Karthik —

Quick note following our closing last week. Scallop has completed the acquisition of WaveBench and we are consolidating finance under the new legal entity for vendor invoicing:

  - Legal name for invoicing: Scallop Technologies Ltd.
  - Registered address: 14 North Dock, Dublin, Ireland
  - VAT (EU) ID: IE1234567F
  - Preferred remit via bank transfer (IBAN and bank contact below).

Can Redwood update future invoices to the Scallop Technologies Ltd. name and remit address? Also, on VAT — will Redwood apply the reverse-charge (B2B intra-EU) on future invoices, or do you need any additional documentation from our side?

Bank contact for verification: Suresh Iyer (suresh.iyer@corpbank.eu) — he can confirm the IBAN once you request it.

We can provide a signed amendment to your master services agreement; attaching a copy after this message. Ideally we want the cutover to be effective on invoices dated 2028-09-01 forward. For any outstanding invoices, please advise if you need us to request reissue or if Redwood can redirect payments.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Emily Park
Head of Finance, Scallop Tech
emily.park@scalloptech.com
+353 1 555 0123

-----

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@scalloptech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Sep 2028 10:03:18 -0700
Subject: Re: Remittance update & EU VAT residency clarification (Scallop Tech acquisition)

Hi Emily —

Thanks — congrats on completing the acquisition. Looping in Monica from Finance and Laura from Legal so we can confirm the correct process and timeline. A couple of quick items so we can process this without payment delay: 

  1) Can you confirm the exact legal name to appear on the invoice (as it should be printed)? You used 'Scallop Technologies Ltd.' above but we need the precise registered string.
  2) Please attach the signed amendment (if available) and any certificate of incorporation / change of name so our AP team can perform KYC.
  3) Confirm whether you want the cutover effective for invoices dated 2028-09-01 or only future invoice cycles.

Monica — can Finance confirm what documents we require to: update remit address, change bank routing for ACH/SEPA, and apply the reverse-charge on EU invoices?

I want to make sure we avoid routing a payment to the old entity.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

-----

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@scalloptech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Sep 2028 11:47:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Remittance update & EU VAT residency clarification (Scallop Tech acquisition)

Hi Emily —

Thanks for the heads up and congrats on the close. I work in Redwood billing — I can take care of the remittance update. To proceed we need the following (standard finance checklist):

  - Signed amendment that authorizes us to change the invoicing entity (please attach; you mentioned you would send it).
  - Official company registration or change-of-name certificate showing the new legal name and VAT number.
  - Bank confirmation contact (we will reach out to Suresh to validate IBAN/BIC).
  - Exact remit address for the invoice footer and for any tax reporting.

I've attached a draft of the next invoice with the proposed legal name and address (attachment: invoice_7890_draft.pdf). If everything looks correct we can reissue the outstanding invoice and apply the new entity for invoices going forward. Reissue timing: once we receive the docs above we typically reissue within 48 business hours.

About VAT/reverse-charge: for intra-EU B2B transactions the reverse charge can apply when:

  - The supplier (Redwood) issues an invoice to a VAT-registered business in another EU member state, and
  - The customer's valid EU VAT number is on record.

If Scallop is VAT-registered in Ireland (IE1234567F) and provides a valid VAT number, we will set the invoice to indicate 'reverse charge — VAT accounted for by the customer' and leave the VAT line at 0%. However, we need the registration docs to keep on file. If Scallop expects Redwood to charge VAT (for any reason), please flag that now.

Next steps from our side:
  - When you send the signed amendment and registration certificate, we will:
    * Verify the bank details via Suresh,
    * Update the billing entity in our system, and
    * Reissue the prior unpaid invoice and produce a remittance advice.

I'll also send the DocuSign amendment (if you prefer electronic signature) — link below.

DocuSign amendment: https://www.docusign.com/embedded?token=ABC123

Best,
Monica Patel
Finance Manager — Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

Attachment: invoice_7890_draft.pdf

-----

From: Emily Park <emily.park@scalloptech.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Suresh Iyer <suresh.iyer@corpbank.eu>
Date: Fri, 8 Sep 2028 14:02:15 +0100
Subject: Re: Remittance update & EU VAT residency clarification (Scallop Tech acquisition)

Hi Monica —

Thanks, attached is the signed amendment (signed_amendment_scallop.pdf) and the company registration extract showing the VAT number IE1234567F. Please confirm receipt.

Suresh — I copied you here; please reply with confirmation of the IBAN so Redwood can validate. Our preferred IBAN is GB29SCALLOP00012345678 (we can provide a separate bank mandate if needed).

We'd prefer Redwood to reissue the unpaid invoice and set the new legal name with an effective date of 2028-09-01. Please send the remittance advice so our AP queue can match it for payment.

Let me know if anything else is required.

Best,
Emily

Attachment: signed_amendment_scallop.pdf

-----

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@scalloptech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 8 Sep 2028 11:45:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Remittance update & EU VAT residency clarification (Scallop Tech acquisition)

Emily —

Thanks for the attachments and for looping us in. Monica — appreciate you taking point. Confirming next steps from Redwood: 

  - Finance will validate Suresh's IBAN confirmation and update our AP records.
  - Once validation completes (target within 24 hours), we will reissue the outstanding invoice to 'Scallop Technologies Ltd.' and mark it with the reverse-charge note (assuming VAT docs are in order).
  - Expect a reissued invoice + remittance advice within 48 hours.

Emily, if you can confirm by reply that the IBAN provided is the primary settlement account and that your AP team will accept the reissued invoice, we'll prioritize this in the collections queue.

HubSpot deal for reference: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/4742
DocuSign amendment (signed): https://www.docusign.com/embedded?token=ABC123

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Senior Director, Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
